sources.title: GitHub - FrenchKnuckles/ANLP_A1
sources.snippet: This repository contains a PyTorch implementation of a Seq2Seq Transformer trained to decrypt a substitution cipher. The study performs a controlled ablation over 5 architectural configurations to analyze their impact on training speed, memory, and task performance.

sources.title: Decrypt a Message - Cipher Identifier - Online Code Recognizer
sources.snippet: Tool to identify/recognize the type of encryption/encoding applied to a message (more 200 ciphers/codes are detectable). Cipher identifier to quickly decrypt/decode any text.

sources.title: PixVerse Introduces C1, an AI Video Model Built for Film Production
sources.snippet: PixVerse announces C1, its first AI video model for film production: action and effects, storyboard-to-video, reference-guided consistency, up to 1080p and 15 seconds with audio.

sources.title: Transformer (deep learning) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: The transformer model has been implemented in standard deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Transformers is a library produced by Hugging Face that supplies transformer-based architectures and pretrained models.
